summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (N19) proposing a research design to test whether Rhodiola rosea SHR-5's fatigue/cognition phenotype is independent of HPA/cortisol-class mediation. The document is a pre-registered research discussion (not yet executed) that identifies a gap in existing literature: no published study has abolished cortisol-class fatigue attribution with hydrocortisone or a cortisol-matched challenge and then scored residual SHR-5 phenotype on the same panel. The project is at TRL 1–2, as it is a conceptual hypothesis with supporting literature priors but no experimental execution.

content_blocks.title: Hypothesis / Claim (N19)
content_blocks.content: On a pre-registered acute/subacute human fatigue/attention/cognition panel with a cortisol-class positive attribution arm, a hydrocortisone or stressor cortisol-matched challenge that abolishes cortisol-class fatigue/cognition attribution, and a Rhodiola rosea SHR-5 arm: under the same condition that abolishes cortisol-class fatigue/cognition attribution, SHR-5 retains residual fatigue reduction/cognitive phenotype ≥50% of SHR-5-alone (fatigue/attention/cognition units as pre-specified; α/N pre-specified). Novelty tag: assumption-kill / hpa-insufficiency. Polarity: negative. Status: NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: Rhodiola SHR-5 is framed via stress-fatigue/attention phenotypes with salivary cortisol as an outcome, but existing trial arms do not abolish cortisol-class fatigue attribution with hydrocortisone or a cortisol-matched challenge. N19 asks whether residual SHR-5 fatigue/cognition phenotype survives an HPA/cortisol-matched challenge that kills cortisol-class fatigue attribution — an 'hpa-insufficiency assumption-kill.' Distinct from N15 (modafinil PVT under DAT-matched block), N16 (creatine plasma/PCr), N17 (Hericium×NGF/TrkA), N18 (L-theanine×adenosine).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Standardised Rhodiola rosea SHR-5 moves human fatigue/attention/mental-work phenotypes under stress; some trials measure salivary cortisol as a biomarker/outcome. No published head-to-head abolishes cortisol-class fatigue/cognition attribution with hydrocortisone or a stressor cortisol-matched challenge and scores residual SHR-5 fatigue reduction/cognitive phenotype on the same panel. Preferred design: same-panel acute/subacute human fatigue/attention/cognition lock with cortisol-class positive attribution ± hydrocortisone or named stressor cortisol-matched abolish condition vs SHR-5 ± same condition. Optional cell/SPR overlay only if a named published HPA-challenge system locks residual first.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Baseline
content_blocks.content:
Four key prior art references identified, all showing SHR-5 phenotype without HPA-abolish arm:
1. PMID 19016404 (Olsson 2009, Planta Med): SHR-5 improves fatigue/QoL/attention and decreases saliva cortisol response to awakening in stress-related fatigue — cortisol is outcome, not matched abolish arm; not residual-under-block H2H.
2. PMID 10839209 (Spasov 2000, Phytomedicine): SHR-5 vs placebo during examination stress — physical fitness/mental fatigue/neuro-motoric endpoints; no hydrocortisone abolish arm.
3. PMID 11081987 (Darbinyan 2000, Phytomedicine): Repeated low-dose SHR-5 on Fatigue Index/mental performance in physicians during night duty; no cortisol-matched abolish arm.
4. PMID 12725561 (Shevtsov 2003, Phytomedicine): Two SHR-5 doses vs placebo on antifatigue index/capacity for mental work; no hydrocortisone/HPA-matched abolish arm.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat N1–N18 as proving N19 — N15 is residual modafinil PVT under DAT-matched block; N16 is plasma-Cr↑ without ³¹P PCr; N17 is Hericium residual under NGF/TrkA block; N18 is L-theanine residual under caffeine-matched adenosine; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual gain.
2. Cortisol-as-outcome ≠ residual-under-block H2H — Olsson/Noreen measure salivary cortisol as biomarker/outcome; they do not abolish cortisol-class attribution with hydrocortisone or matched cortisol challenge and score residual SHR-5 on the same panel.
3. Phenotype priors lack HPA-insufficiency arms; lock same-panel acute/subacute human fatigue/attention/cognition with cortisol-class positive attribution ± hydrocortisone or stressor cortisol-matched challenge vs SHR-5 ± same condition; no dosing; NOT MB/MAOI; not N15/N16/N17/N18 clones; do not burn ip_class=none.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered acute/subacute human fatigue/attention/cognition panel, under hydrocortisone or a stressor cortisol-matched challenge that abolishes cortisol-class fatigue/cognition attribution, residual SHR-5 fatigue reduction/cognitive phenotype falls below 50% of SHR-5-alone (fatigue/attention/cognition units as pre-specified) — so HPA/cortisol-class sufficiency for SHR-5 phenotype survives and hpa-insufficiency fails — when abolish-gate, SHR-5-alone comparator, and power/assay artifacts are ruled out.

content_blocks.title: Ablation Analysis
content_blocks.content:
Three ablation conditions identified:
1. Remove same-panel contrast of residual SHR-5 under hydrocortisone/cortisol-matched challenge: Without the abolish×residual H2H on an Olsson/Spasov/Darbinyan/Shevtsov-class panel with cortisol-class positive attribution, separate fatigue LITERATURE and cortisol-as-outcome LITERATURE cannot show hpa-insufficiency.
2. Remove verified abolish gate plus SHR-5-alone comparator: Without verified cortisol-class abolish and SHR-5-alone comparator under the same condition, residual SHR-5 is just 'another adaptogen under nonspecific HPA challenge,' not an assumption-kill.
3. Remove N15≠N19 + N16≠N19 + N17≠N19 + N18≠N19 + soft-complete-empty≠novelty discipline: Treating adjacent results as already deciding residual SHR-5 under HPA/cortisol-matched block would invent an H2H result left UNKNOWN.

key_findings: N19 is a pre-registered, NOT_RUN hypothesis card proposing an HPA/cortisol-class assumption-kill experiment for Rhodiola rosea SHR-5 — TRL 1 (conceptual stage).

Four published RCTs (Olsson 2009, Spasov 2000, Darbinyan 2000, Shevtsov 2003) establish SHR-5 fatigue/cognition phenotype priors but none include a hydrocortisone or cortisol-matched abolish arm — the key experimental gap.
The critical unknown (matched_residual_SHR5_under_HPA_cortisol_matched_H2H) is explicitly UNKNOWN with soft-complete 0 true co-panel found in literature search.
Prediction threshold: residual SHR-5 fatigue reduction/cognitive phenotype ≥50% of SHR-5-alone while cortisol-class attribution is abolished under the same HPA/cortisol-matched challenge.
Refutation criterion: residual SHR-5 phenotype <50% of SHR-5-alone under the abolish condition (with abolish-gate, SHR-5-alone comparator, and power/assay artifacts ruled out).
IP class: hpa-insufficiency; kill_cost_tier=2; estimated time_to_refute=6 weeks; vault_hold=no.
FTO status is UNKNOWN; execution has not started.

Competing caveats include: abolish condition fails to kill cortisol-class attribution, SHR-5-alone null, underpowered strata, or assay-identity mismatch — all pre-registered as inconclusive rather than refutation outcomes.
N15 (modafinil-DAT), N16 (creatine/PCr), N17 (Hericium/NGF/TrkA), N18 (L-theanine/adenosine) are explicitly distinguished as non-proof of N19.
